sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.verification_scope: Read parsed paper text and experimental framing; no independent replication.
sources.finding: The experiments show position-sensitive retrieval in the studied long-context tasks; the result is not a universal threshold for current models.

sources.title: Effective harnesses for long-running agents
sources.verification_scope: Relevant parsed documentation sections; not an authenticated CLI experiment.
sources.finding: Durable progress artifacts, incremental changes and explicit tests support work that crosses context windows.

sources.title: Agents, adapted from AI Engineering
sources.verification_scope: Read the author-published agents chapter excerpt. The complete AI Engineering book was not accessed.
sources.finding: Planning, tools and evaluation introduce their own failure modes and costs; agent quality needs end-to-end measurement.

sources.title: AI engineering pitfalls
sources.verification_scope: Relevant parsed documentation sections; not an authenticated CLI experiment.
sources.finding: Prefer deterministic solutions where sufficient and evaluate before increasing system complexity.

sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
sources.verification_scope: Read parsed paper sections; no reproduction or generalization of reported benchmark percentages.
sources.finding: The paper studies verbal feedback and episodic memory with task feedback; it does not establish that an unverified failure narrative is correct.

sources.title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models
sources.verification_scope: Read parsed paper framing and mechanism; no replication and no claim of gains for this skill.
sources.finding: Incremental context curation is evaluated as an alternative to repeatedly compressing an entire evolving playbook.

sources.title: FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance
sources.verification_scope: Read paper abstract and method framing; published savings are not measurements of this repository.
sources.finding: Cascades can trade model cost against task quality when evaluated on a defined workload.

sources.title: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs from Preference Data
sources.verification_scope: Read parsed paper sections; no model training or reproduction.
sources.finding: Learned routing uses workload evidence; preference labels and software acceptance are different targets.

sources.title: AutoMix: Automatically Mixing Language Models
sources.verification_scope: Read parsed paper mechanism and evaluation framing; not a live routing trial.
sources.finding: Noisy self-verification can support routing policies, but its assumptions require evaluation and do not replace deterministic software tests.

sources.title: Create custom subagents
sources.verification_scope: Relevant parsed documentation sections; not an authenticated CLI experiment.

sources.title: Manage costs effectively

sources.title: Prompt caching

sources.title: Security

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.verification_scope: Relevant parsed documentation sections; not an authenticated CLI experiment.
